# Farol 1.2.0
- Clearer worktree removal confirmation, with branch, path, and change status shown before removal. - Better handling for worktree and branch names in the menu, including long names. - Improved discovery of installed Xcode editors. - Settings now opens without an initially focused control.

# Farol 1.1.0
- Free plan for tracking one project at a time, with unlimited worktrees. - Farol license unlocks unlimited projects and automatic worktree setup and cleanup scripts. - Guided onboarding and contextual upgrade prompts. - New, redesigned native Settings window with clearer navigation and project-specific app selections. - Gentle reminders when a Farol update is available. - Localization in 🇪🇸 Spanish and 🇧🇷 Brazilian Portuguese. - More reliable worktree switching, removal, and setup automation.

# Farol 1.0.0
Initial release!
- Discover Git worktrees automatically across your projects - See changed files and unpushed commits at a glance - Open worktrees in your editor or terminal - Run setup scripts when a new worktree appears - Review changes and run cleanup scripts before removing a worktree
